failure_modes.name: Missing_Evidence_Not_Specified
failure_modes.evidence: The solver summaries state 'Missing Information: 1. Who composed Raymonda (the ballet or opera)? 2. Did the composer of Raymonda serve as director of the Bill Sawyer Orchestra? 3. When did the composer of Raymonda start composing Symphony No. 9 in D minor?' and 'Still Missing: Information about the ballet/opera Raymonda and its composer. Connection between Raymonda's composer and the Bill Sawyer Orchestra. Details about when Raymonda's composer began work on Symphony No. 9 in D minor.' Neither summary identifies who the composer of Raymonda is (Alexander Glazunov), leaving retrieval with no concrete entity to target.

failure_modes.name: Query_Form_Mismatch
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 2 query: 'Who composed Raymonda ballet?' - This is a natural-language yes/no question format rather than a structured entity query. Hop 3 query: 'Alexander Glazunov Symphony No. 9 in D minor Bill Sawyer Orchestra director' - This is keyword soup bundling multiple targets (Glazunov, Symphony No. 9, Bill Sawyer Orchestra, director role) without clear structure.

failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: All three hop queries target the same core information: Hop 1 ('Bill Sawyer Orchestra Raymonda Symphony No. 9 in D minor composer'), Hop 2 ('Who composed Raymonda ballet?'), and Hop 3 ('Alexander Glazunov Symphony No. 9 in D minor Bill Sawyer Orchestra director') all attempt to connect Raymonda's composer with the Bill Sawyer Orchestra and Symphony No. 9. The queries reword the same targets without advancing based on hop 1-2 findings that Wilson Sawyer led the Bill Sawyer Orchestra but composed only Symphony No. 1.

failure_modes.name: Solver_Irrelevant_Passage_Overprocessing
failure_modes.evidence: Solver extensively analyzes passages about Victor Yampolsky, David Itkin, Fred Stone, Huw Edwards, and multiple other conductors/composers in all three hops, despite these being clearly irrelevant to the claim. For example, hop 2 reasoning states: 'Victor Yampolsky... is a Russian-born conductor... David Itkin... is an American conductor and composer... Fred Stone... was a Canadian flugelhornist...' None of these figures connect to Raymonda, yet significant analysis is devoted to them across multiple hops.

failure_modes.name: Repetitive_Output_Loop
failure_modes.evidence: The solver produces nearly identical analyses across all three hops. Each hop concludes with variants of: 'Missing Information: 1. Who composed Raymonda... 2. Did the composer of Raymonda serve as director of the Bill Sawyer Orchestra? 3. When did the composer of Raymonda start composing Symphony No. 9 in D minor?' The same three missing elements are restated without progress in verification or gap refinement.
